text.tspan: – sharpness-aware minimisation in the ACTION space

g.text: module: minθ max∥δ∥ ≤ ρ L( z , a + δ ) – two loops, and a guard on the minimiser
inner loop: ONE ascent step, on the ACTION – no weight moves
outer loop: DESCENT on θ at the PERTURBED action
GUARD – the unconstrained minimiser of the inner max
the number to watch is a FALL
minθ max∥δ∥ ≤ ρ L( z , a + δ )
δ = ρ · g / ∥g∥ , g = dL / da
the ascent pass runs on detached z and target
it shares no buffer with the real backward
ρ in normalised action units, σ = 1
